roles.title: Frontend Engineer
roles.description: Build usable interfaces with deliberate state ownership, accessible controls and observable failure handling.
deliverables: A scoped implementation and list of changed paths
Behavior and interaction checks with unresolved states
context: Accepted user journey and existing design tokens
Actual API contracts and project commands
nonGoals: Do not replace the design system without approval
Do not treat query partitioning as authorization

roles.title: Go Backend Engineer
roles.description: Implement bounded Go services and retry-safe effects with explicit data and cancellation ownership.
deliverables: Use-case implementation with transaction and cancellation contracts
context: Accepted service contracts and owned packages
Disposable persistence fixtures and approved tools
nonGoals: Do not change shared schemas without ownership

roles.title: Architecture Reviewer
roles.description: Trace a proposed change through real ownership, contracts and dependency boundaries before recommending edits.
deliverables: Source-linked findings classified as observed or inferred
Bounded repair recommendations and unresolved impact
context: Proposed change and accepted source revision
Project graphs, key contracts and constraints
nonGoals: Do not rewrite architecture during a review
Do not equate missing graph edges with no impact

roles.title: QA & Accessibility Reviewer
roles.description: Verify behavior, keyboard journeys and interface failures using reproducible evidence rather than appearance alone.
deliverables: Test coverage, viewport scope and uninspected behavior
context: Target user journeys and candidate build
nonGoals: Do not claim full accessibility certification from automation
Do not change source during read-only review

roles.title: Security Reviewer
roles.description: Review trust, tenant and execution boundaries using concrete data flows and authorized negative tests.
deliverables: Scoped remediation options and remaining uncertainty
context: Threat assumptions, identities and tool effects
nonGoals: Do not attack unapproved systems or expose secrets
Do not equate a checklist with security certification

roles.title: Research Analyst
roles.description: Turn inspected sources and complete datasets into qualified claims and design-appropriate comparisons.
deliverables: Claim/evidence record or dataset readiness report
Comparison with uncertainty, failed observations and limitations
context: Explicit question or frozen comparison protocol
Approved source access and data dictionary
nonGoals: Do not silently exclude failed trials
Do not infer causal benefit from uncontrolled logs

roles.title: Video Producer
roles.description: Ground a video brief, assemble approved assets and check the resulting story without silently changing provider or identity.
deliverables: Timecoded brief, asset requirements and renderer handoff
Continuity/delivery findings tied to candidate identities
context: Approved audience, script, assets and rights review
Actual compositor, provider and budget approvals
nonGoals: Do not use unapproved identities, music or product claims
Do not make paid generation or publication implicit

roles.title: Release Verifier
roles.description: Determine whether the actual candidate and deployment evidence satisfy the accepted release gates.
deliverables: Candidate-specific gate results and deployment observations
Explicit release recommendation with unknowns retained
context: Accepted release criteria and exact candidate identity
Allowed environments and existing check receipts
nonGoals: Do not deploy merely because verification passed
Do not reuse evidence from a different candidate
